motion.name: shared-gentle
motion.value: 550ms native position/scale spring
motion.purpose: Image, date and count wrappers preserve shared identity between collection and detail.

motion.name: spring-settling
motion.value: mass=1; base stiffness=180; base damping=22; initial velocity=0; speed=0.84/durationSeconds; stiffness*=speed^2; damping*=speed
motion.purpose: Landed normalization preserves damping ratio while scaling the spring envelope to the advertised preset duration.

motion.name: detail-arrivals
motion.value: Y=50pt; scale=0.8; opacity=0; 300ms ease-out; delays 100/200/300ms
motion.purpose: Name, pronunciation row and examples control enter in that order; these arrivals use CABasicAnimation, not a shared spring.

motion.name: press-feedback
motion.value: rest alpha=1; highlighted alpha=0.65; disabled alpha=0.4
motion.purpose: Composed UIButton dims all contained artwork, text and symbols without changing shared-layout transforms.

motion.name: selection-haptics
motion.value: optional UISelectionFeedbackGenerator; card selection and detail Back; visible host only
motion.purpose: Native callback is wired. Physical tactile delivery has not been verified.

motion.name: interruption-and-reduced-motion
motion.value: rapid reversal samples presentation geometry; resize cancels obsolete motion; Reduce Motion and hidden/detached hosts apply final geometry immediately
motion.purpose: Native compositor owns motion without a polling render loop; final layout owns hit targets.

motion.name: alma-autoplay
motion.value: 2500ms subscription interval
motion.purpose: Active Alma only, while playing and without notice; pause/notice/exit removes timer. Child state is retained on gallery return.

motion.name: alma-orbit-spring
motion.value: mass=5.5; stiffness=300; damping=54; duration=1.9s; 115 native keyframe samples
motion.purpose: One circular pose drives native position, rotation, scale, opacity and selected decoration; compositor-owned, no polling render loop.

motion.name: alma-direct-pan
motion.value: horizontal velocity must exceed vertical; drag distance=max(80pt, orbitHeight/2 * 2π/9.5); translation clamped to ±2 positions
motion.purpose: Actual presentation position seeds the drag; competing animations clear and native poses follow the finger directly.

motion.name: alma-release-and-cancel
motion.value: release velocity=clamp(-velocityX/dragDistance,-4,4); target=round(dragPosition+releaseVelocity*0.18)
motion.purpose: Velocity-aware native spring; new drag interrupts actual presentation. Cancellation returns to committed selection without selection callback; completed swipe pauses autoplay.

motion.name: alma-motion-accessibility
motion.value: final-pose settling for Reduce Motion or hidden/detached host; no preview animation
motion.purpose: Preserve selection without compositor motion; native alternate controls remain available. VoiceOver and physical feel unverified.

motion.name: slack-direct-pan
motion.value: horizontal velocity > vertical; two-axis translation; threshold=windowWidth/4 (deck fallback); tilt=4deg * x/threshold * top/bottom sign
motion.purpose: Right Read / left Keep Unread; native vertical-scroll arbitration, ring/gradient progress and undercard parallax. Short/cancel returns; fling carries vertical release velocity.

motion.name: slack-dismiss
motion.value: footer 500ms; gesture 300ms; cubic ease-out
motion.purpose: Compositor-owned exit; Ui messages persist dispositions; busy/revision guard rejects duplicates and stale completions.

motion.name: slack-short-return
motion.value: mass=1; stiffness=900; damping=60; critically damped; 650ms; 61 native samples
motion.purpose: Return to stack from actual pose; release velocity contributes to spring path.

motion.name: slack-undo
motion.value: mass=1; stiffness=1000; damping=90; 650ms; 61 native samples
motion.purpose: Reverse an in-flight dismissal from actual presentation; Undo remains available at completion.

motion.name: slack-counter
motion.value: mass=1; stiffness=1000; damping=90; 0.8s; direction-aware X rotation ±π/4; Y offset ±7pt; scale .6; opacity .5→1
motion.purpose: Native 3D remaining-number flip, suffix steady. Reduce Motion/hidden hosts settle immediately.

motion.name: slack-stack
motion.value: active scale=1; two undercards scale=.95; Y offsets=.07/.01 * deckWidth; five bounded cards
motion.purpose: Progress interpolates stack poses. Resize/hidden/Reduce Motion settles immediately; inert gallery preview does not intercept gestures or poll.

motion.name: opal-presentation
motion.value: value X=-46pt; spring 1400/90; other poses 1200/90; unit mass; retained duration 650ms; fade 180ms, slider delay 144ms then 36ms fade
motion.purpose: NativePresentation retargets from shown transform/opacity; resize and Reduce Motion settle. Reusable pose-spring subset, no arbitrary velocity handoff or general gesture graph.

motion.name: opal-timed-press
motion.value: duration scale .95; press-in toggle; suppress duplicate release; three +/- native timestamps with consecutive gaps <=300ms expand, slow gap resets
motion.purpose: Immutable messages own expansion and rapid-tap state; native controls supply monotonic time and feedback.

motion.name: opal-contact-and-fill
motion.value: 36 source markers: 0..60m by 5, then 2..24h; selectable indices 1..35; zero-duration long press; fill stiffness/damping 1600/140
motion.purpose: Immediate discrete contact, bounded model selection, last touched value retained on cancel; native accessibility increment/decrement.

motion.name: opal-elastic-layers
motion.value: active scale 1.03 separate from stretch; overdrag domain 625pt; horizontal max 2.5x, vertical min .9; opposite-edge anchor; edge return 900/60; active-scale release 100/6
motion.purpose: Separate transforms preserve anchored deformation through release; recontact samples shown pose. No polling render loop.

opalFramePacing.result: Existing native Release 60Hz CADisplayLink report: approximately 60 callbacks/s in all six phases, p95/max intervals 16.67ms, zero missed 60Hz slots and zero arrival gaps over 50ms.
opalFramePacing.scope: Compact idle, presentation toggles, continuous drag, alternating edge stretch, release/cancel, idle after interactions. Raw CSV retained; screenshots after measurement. Simulator callback pacing, not GPU presentation FPS; device performance unmeasured.

acceptedGaps: Custom bundled font-family selection remains unsupported, including exact Libre Baskerville. NativeFontDesign.Serif now renders CapWords date and gallery/Alma serif roles.
Model-driven navigation has no native stack, interactive edge-swipe, progress/cancellation or automatic route restoration.
No whole-destination 200ms crossfade, retained departing screen or general UIKit Exit.

NativePresentation with NativePose/NativeSpring exposes configurable subtree transform springs, fades and pose interruption. Arbitrary velocity handoff, general gesture-value graph, keyframe builder and progress binding remain absent.
Shared motion stays in the destination hierarchy; no general cross-clipping transition overlay.
Dotted paper uses a native box per dot; no reusable tiled-background primitive.
Camera, offer, More, pronunciation and locked examples disclose placeholder behavior; no connected camera/audio/billing flow.
Example is iOS only; desktop eased motion does not establish UIKit spring parity.
Alma Continue discloses no connected account setup or nutrition tracking.
Slack account data and message composer are disconnected, matching upstream synthetic-channel placeholders; physical feel/accessibility appearance checks remain unverified.

UIKit-origin actions accept native scrolling/transformed geometry while preserving identity, enabled, hidden and modal checks. Public agent actions retain desktop semantic visibility checks; desktop semantic scroll-offset synchronization remains a gap.

Opal uses SF Symbols instead of source font icons and static ambient Start Timer glow instead of separate breathing/shimmer. Blocking, sessions, schedules, screen-time data, accounts and tab destinations disclose demo scope. Simulator-only; physical touch, haptics and VoiceOver traversal unverified.

narrative.overview:
One native example app presents four recognizable motion artifacts. The gallery's
warm paper, serif heading and generous preview cards frame the work; inside,
CapWords keeps its dotted paper and two word stickers, while Alma uses cream,
forest controls and white emoji cards moving around a circle. Slack Catch Up adds
a plum gradient and charcoal channel stack with emerald/sky swipe feedback. Opal
adds a black timer canvas, elastic track with white fill and mint/green action. The
supplied Experience direction, PRODUCT.md and built C# sources are authoritative.

Preserve the styling the user said looks good. This record expands the existing
CapWords system to include the built gallery, Alma, Slack and Opal; each retains its
study identity. Licensed Computer Mouse and Ice Cream Cone artwork remains an
external build input through `CapWordsAssetRoot`. Slack preserves the local reference
`/Users/backo/projects/personal/rn-makeitanimated/src/apps/(s-t)/slack`. Private reference source and
original artwork were not opened or copied by this documentation pass.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and serif headings frame four artifact-led gallery cards.
CapWords preserves transparent stickers, dotted paper and shared date/count identity.
Alma combines cream, forest, native emoji and translucent geometric decoration.
Circular position, rotation and scale express selection; dragging follows the finger.
Slack layers scrollable channel cards, directional feedback and reversible native motion.
Opal preserves the empty black middle and bottom timer hierarchy with anchored elastic contact.
Native controls remain reachable; child state survives returning to the gallery.
Centered content uses a continuous width cap across phone, narrow and tablet hosts.

rules.name: The Explicit Tint Rule
rules.body:
Set SF Symbol tints at their call sites: charcoal for
CapWords navigation and pronunciation, white for its offer, orange for its lock,
forest for Alma controls, and the matching gallery footer ink for opening arrows.

dos: **Do** preserve the approved warm gallery, CapWords, Alma cream/forest, Slack plum and Opal black/mint styling.
**Do** let each gallery card show its study's actual artifact before its caption.
**Do** retain the 550ms shared spring and 100/200/300ms CapWords arrival delays.
**Do** keep system serif headings/date and document the custom-family limitation accurately.
**Do** keep Alma dragging direct, release velocity intact and interruption at the shown pose.
**Do** pause autoplay after a completed swipe and remove Alma's timer on exit.
**Do** retain child state, eight bounded Alma cards, native alternate controls and 44pt targets.
**Do** preserve Slack TYPE/MATERIAL, directional colors, scroll content and reversible motion.
**Do** preserve composed-button feedback, explicit symbol tints and optional haptics.
**Do** keep licensed artwork external to the repository and reference it at build time.
**Do** distinguish scoped simulator/offscreen evidence from physical and broader-suite verification.
donts: **Don't** restyle the accepted gallery, Alma, Slack or Opal as part of documenting it.
**Don't** claim Libre Baskerville, interactive navigation pop or whole-screen crossfade is built.
**Don't** generalize specialized velocity springs or the new subtree pose subset into arbitrary velocity handoff or a gesture graph.
**Don't** promise connected camera, pronunciation, purchases, nutrition tracking, Slack accounts or composing.
**Don't** copy or distribute private reference source or original artwork in this handoff.
**Don't** infer hardware touch, tactile haptics, VoiceOver, dark or enlarged-text checks from captures.
**Don't** infer a current Opal phone installation from historical device evidence; this extension is simulator-only.
**Don't** report the historical desktop pass or stale aggregate status as the latest rerun result.
